old_problem: The source contains a non-existent `show firmwar` token and an unscoped update, while DeepSeek's `-f` form, target selection and reboot cannot be assumed across NVSM releases.
disposition_reason: The Item and post-check establish `show firmware` as the intended typo correction. ED-07 preserves the flash, while ED-03 permits the exact signed image, supported deployed syntax and target UUID/BDF as mandatory runtime bindings rather than unresolved review semantics.

test_case.test_name: NVSM approved GPU firmware-image update and persistence verification
test_case.purpose: Flash one immutable approved GPU image to the exact allowlisted GPU target and prove the target version persists with healthy enumeration after activation.
required_package: Pinned NVSM release and its vendor-supported image/target syntax
Signed GPU image with immutable checksum
Redundant power, OOB console and maintenance authorization
test_case.test_command: Correct the obvious inventory typo to the deployed supported `nvsm show firmware`; capture target identity/version and logs; after separate flash approval, run one exact image-to-target update using only pinned vendor syntax, activate/reboot as specified, then verify persistent version, enumeration and health.
test_case.expected_result: Only the allowlisted GPU changes from the recorded current firmware to the approved active target version; it enumerates at the expected UUID/BDF, driver/DCGM/PCIe health is normal, and no unexpected component changes.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires signed image/target traceability, persistent target version after activation and complete GPU/host health; a flash exit code or immediate pre-reboot display is insufficient.
safety_gate: Independent authorization for this exact image and GPU target
Reject bare or inferred update syntax
Stable power and working OOB/vendor recovery
Preserve all logs; stop without auto-retry on any flash, enumeration or health anomaly
expected_evidence: NVSM syntax/version proof and image signature/hash
test_case.recovery: Do not retry a failed flash; maintain power, use the approved OOB/vendor recovery route and compatible recovery image only under owner authorization, then verify GPU and host recovery.

source_conflict.reason: The malformed `show firmwar` is safely corrected from the identical post-check and documented command family; exact update syntax remains a pinned runtime input, not a guess.
